a1.speaker: aki
a1.text: Whoa! You're the guy from my drawings! The straw hat, the sad eyes. Look!

a2.speaker: narrator
a2.text: Her sketchbook is full of panels. A shore. A city in fog. A temple with a masked man. And in each one, a samurai in a straw hat - standing over someone who glows.

a3.speaker: aki
a3.text: I dream them. Every world has a protector, and every time the hat man comes... the protector goes out like a lamp.

choices.text: ...What happens at the end of the book?
There's a girl on a shore in this one.

a_hana.speaker: aki
a_hana.text: Yeah! She's holding something on a string and looking at the sea. She used to be crying in that one. Now she isn't. Weird, huh?

a_tobi.speaker: aki
a_tobi.text: A boy and a little girl and a lantern. That one drew itself. I woke up and it was just there.

a_end.speaker: aki
a_end.text: That's the thing - I don't know.

a_dismiss.speaker: aki
a_dismiss.text: Everything's just a drawing here, dummy. ...But okay, even if it is.

a_keep.speaker: aki
a_keep.text: Sure! Here. I'll draw you a happy one later, okay? Promise.

a_lost.speaker: aki
a_lost.text: The last page blew away. Right down the stairs into the old archive under the depot - and stuff nests down there now.

a_lost2.speaker: aki
a_lost2.text: Could you get it back? I'm not finished with it. I can feel it.

again.speaker: aki
again.text: The archive's under the depot - go through the big kiosk, then south, then south again. Watch out for bats! Grandma Iro's down by the kiosk if you need anything.

back2.speaker: narrator
back2.text: She looks at the page for a long time. The hat man kneels. The masked monk's mask is cracked down the middle, and something red looks out.

back3.speaker: aki
back3.text: I don't like this ending. ...Should I keep it? Grandma says you don't erase what's true.

choices.text: Draw a new one. The ending's up to whoever holds the brush.

new_end.speaker: aki
new_end.text: Okay! I'll draw him standing up. Facing the monk. Holding... a light, maybe? Not a sword. I'll figure it out. Here - Grandma's tonic, for the hard part.

keep_end.speaker: aki
keep_end.text: Okay. True things go in the book. I'll just draw the next page better. Here - Grandma's tonic, for the hard part.

after_return.speaker: aki
after_return.text: I'm still drawing! Don't peek. ...Okay, you can peek a tiny bit after you beat the scary mirror thing.

post.speaker: aki
post.text: The hat man in my book... he changed. He looks like you now. Not like the one in the mirrors.

post_show.speaker: narrator
post_show.text: You, turning away from a masked monk. Behind you, every light you didn't take - a shore, a lantern, a page - shining on its own.

post3.speaker: aki
post3.text: It's not finished. You have to go finish it. Take Grandma's last tonics - she said you'd need them more than her bones do.

after_all.speaker: aki
after_all.text: Go finish it. I'll draw the very last panel when you're done. With you smiling, maybe.
